paragraphs.text: When the national museums of one European country abolished entry charges in 2001, visitor numbers rose by an average of 70 per cent within five years. The increase was largest at museums outside the capital.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The change was not free for taxpayers. The government paid the museums an extra grant to replace lost ticket income, although officials argued that the cost was balanced by more spending in museum shops and cafés.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Critics noted that most of the new visitors came from groups who already visited museums often. People from low-income areas, whom the policy was partly meant to attract, increased their visits only slightly.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Some museums have since introduced charges for special exhibitions while keeping the permanent collections free. Their directors say this has raised money without reducing overall visitor numbers.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Several other countries have since studied the policy, but few have copied it in full, mainly because of the cost to national budgets.
paragraphs.label: E

items.quote: The increase was largest at museums outside the capital
keywords: largest at museums outside the capital

explanation.en: “The increase was largest at museums outside the capital” → A. F picks up “five years”, but the policy was not reversed.
explanation.kk: «The increase was largest at museums outside the capital» → A. F «five years» тіркесіне ілінеді, бірақ саясат жойылмаған.
explanation.ru: «The increase was largest at museums outside the capital» → A. F ловит «five years», но политику не отменяли.

items.quote: The change was not free for taxpayers.

explanation.en: “The change was not free for taxpayers” → B: the government paid an extra grant.
explanation.kk: «The change was not free for taxpayers» → B: мемлекет қосымша грант төлеген.
explanation.ru: «The change was not free for taxpayers» → B: государство платило дополнительный грант.

items.quote: officials argued that the cost was balanced by more spending in museum shops and cafés
items.prompt: According to officials, the cost of the policy

explanation.en: Officials argued “the cost was balanced by more spending in museum shops and cafés” → G.
explanation.kk: Шенеуніктер «the cost was balanced by more spending in museum shops and cafés» деп санаған → G.
explanation.ru: Чиновники считали, что «the cost was balanced by more spending in museum shops and cafés» → G.

items.quote: most of the new visitors came from groups who already visited museums often

explanation.en: Critics note that “most of the new visitors came from groups who already visited museums often” — mostly existing museum-goers → C.
explanation.kk: Сыншылар «most of the new visitors came from groups who already visited museums often» дейді. Жаңа келушілердің көбі — бұрыннан мұражай сүйетіндер → C.
explanation.ru: Критики отмечают, что «most of the new visitors came from groups who already visited museums often». Новые посетители — в основном прежние любители музеев → C.

items.quote: this has raised money without reducing overall visitor numbers

explanation.en: The directors say “this has raised money without reducing overall visitor numbers” → E. D says the opposite.
explanation.kk: Директорлар: «this has raised money without reducing overall visitor numbers» → E. D керісінше айтады.
explanation.ru: Директора говорят: «this has raised money without reducing overall visitor numbers» → E. D утверждает обратное.

still had a cost for taxpayers.
